audit_scope: Independent local metadata, collected source identity acceptance, replayed image hash and visual audit; terminal bytes independently hashed by remote metadata collector, not transferred or loaded locally.

timing.interpretation: Timing at 256x256 on this 32-pair caption cohort; full-pool token lengths and checkpoint/evaluation overhead may change throughput.

visual_findings.train_02098: Warm-start clock correctly shows 3:41; after six joint updates displays 3:44. Rectangular black clock and cream wall retained, layout changes.
visual_findings.train_01677: Both depict pine/grill/stone-wall scene; final places the pine inside a basket rather than preserving a separate dirt patch, logs and tool basket.
visual_findings.qual_dev_00000: Both PRISM stages fail to separate dog and penguin. Final is a simplified combined figure. Native same-seed reference depicts a dog and smaller penguin, with incorrect placement/scale.
visual_findings.qual_dev_00001: At the smoke seed both PRISM stages miss requested two airplanes. Initial has a wheeled cart-like object; final becomes a stylized road/sign scene. Native same-seed reference depicts yellow and silver planes.
visual_findings.cross_run_limit: Prior region diagnostic used different noise seeds for both subjects, so earlier recognizable aircraft versus smoke absence cannot establish training-induced degradation. Within-smoke comparisons do hold noise fixed.

recommendation.next: Diagnose the completed joint-six checkpoint with actual matched/wrong-caption noisy-input/timestep hashes, the preceding diagnostic fixed cases/seeds, and native conditioning on the same adapted DiT; retain original native same-seed image reference. Do not extend joint training or start full data solely on this smoke.
recommendation.later_bounded_teacher_alignment: Justified as a hypothesis if residual content/semantic errors persist: 32-caption alignment content cosine is 0.9437 train versus 0.8634 held-out, despite nearly exact prefix/suffix. More diverse prepared training captions with untouched validation may improve generalization, but this gap does not prove more data resolves generation. Use a separately audited cohort/objective protocol and compare original DiT without joint-update confounding.
recommendation.alternative_control: If completed-joint diagnosis confirms degradation, inspect connector feature drift and consider a lower connector learning-rate or explicitly recorded alignment-retention objective before another joint run; six steps do not establish a general learning-rate conclusion.
